description:
Search financial data and return an answer with an inline widget.

    Covers stocks, macro, forex, crypto, commodities, earnings, technicals,
    and related market questions. Pass the user's question in `query` without
    rephrasing.

    To screen a named watchlist or portfolio, call list_watchlists or
    list_portfolios first, then pass the symbols here with filter criteria in
    `query`.

    Exclusive modes when a Deep Dive exists:
      focus=ai + section=… → narrative section
      focus=raw + source=… → thin data slice
      focus=catalog → list available Deep Dives

    Args:
        query: The user's financial question
        symbols: Optional ticker universe to screen (e.g. from list_watchlists)
        section: Optional Deep Dive section (competition, valuation, thesis,
            forecast, analyst_consensus, people, financials, earnings,
            technicals, overview, moves, markets, flow, calendar, catalysts, odds)
            or raw tapes: options, buzz, acceleration, heatmap, etf, bonds.
            The ETF board is section=etf with no ticker. One fund's holdings
            are section=etf plus that ticker. The bond board is section=bonds.
            A TIPS yield labeled real is the real yield. A spread marked n/a
            stays n/a. Do not use an option-adjusted spread as the page spread.
            Thesis is section=thesis and opens /stock/T/thesis.
            Business is section=competition (/stock/T/competition).
            Price is /stock/T/overview; Large Moves on that tab are section=moves.
            Forecast narrative is section=forecast (/stock/T/analysis).
            Street targets and stance are section=analyst_consensus (/stock/T/valuation).
            Dividends, buybacks, and the alignment / allocation boxes are
            section=financials. There is no Capital section.
            Buzz, social media, reddit, twitter, sentiment, or what people are
            talking about MUST be section=buzz. Do not send those to news or
            catalysts. Consumer sentiment and analyst sentiment are not Buzz.
            Stocks accelerating, price acceleration, speeding up, or speeding
            down MUST be section=acceleration. Do not send those to movers.
            Revenue, earnings, and growth acceleration are not this board.
            Advance/decline, names within 10% of the 52-week high or low, or
            the market P/S, P/E, and P/FCF medians MUST be section=heatmap.
            Do not send those to the sector treemap. One company's P/E is not
            this row.
            One name's options, realized vol, vola, call or put volume, or
            call or put premium MUST be section=options. The 21-day realized
            vol is a yearly rate that places the percentile strikes. A band
            word compares today's session with the prior 20 sessions.
            A press release, presentation, 10-Q, or 10-K for one ticker is
            section=earnings, focus=raw, source=earnings_documents. That is
            not the Earnings write-up.
            Stocks Flow lines are Insiders, Politicians, Institutional, and
            Large Holders. Pass those questions verbatim and do not set
            section=flow. section=flow is only the Flow Deep Dive. Open,
            Increase, Decrease, and Close are the four moves. A politician
            Purchase is an Increase and a plain Sale is a Decrease; an
            asterisk means the form did not say. Institutional ETFs and
            Stocks are a listing. Latest, Largest, and Best are gone. Large
            Holders is 13D and 13G. Do not invent a dollar value there.
        focus: Optional exclusive mode: ai | raw | auto | catalog
        source: Optional thin raw slice when focus=raw (comparison_peers,
            price_targets, consensus, quote, key_financials,
            earnings_documents, …)
        strategy_id: Optional strategy UUID from list_strategies. When set,
            the card this search writes keeps that id.
name: finance_search
title: Search financial data
